title: People’s Mañanera September 7
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**42.8 Million Mexicans: Well-Being Has Become a Right  
** With spending of more than 1 trillion pesos (US$59.08 billion), the Fourth
Transformation (4T) guarantees direct assistance to the beneficiaries of the
government's social programs. Among them, 13.7 million seniors receive 6,400
pesos (US$378) every two months. Rights are maintained and expanded. The next
step will be to provide more scholarships and stipends to college students.

**Well-Being That Reaches Households and Communities  
** The 4T brings rights to the people. There have been 23 million "Health
House-to-House" healthcare visits, and more than 445,000 farmers receive 6,450
pesos (US$381) monthly. All these programs share the same conviction: the poor
come first.

**Wages, Well-Being, and Investment: The Formula for Continuing to Reduce
Poverty  
** After lifting 13.7 million Mexicans out of poverty, the goal is for the
minimum wage to cover 2.5 times the cost of the basic food basket. More than 1
trillion pesos (US$58.08 billion) is being allocated to well-being spending.
President Claudia Sheinbaum affirmed that "we're doing well, and we're going
to do even better."

**Fobaproa: The Debt of Neoliberalism That the People Continue to Pay  
** Decades later, Mexico continues to pay off the Bank Savings Protection Fund
(Fobaproa). The President warned that payments will extend even beyond
2050—the date initially estimated for the debt's repayment. The Ministry of
Finance will explain how it was designed, how it evolved, and why it continues
to weigh on the people.

**Fox and Alito: The PRIAN Returns to the Past Because It Has No Future  
** For decades, the PRI and the PAN pretended to be adversaries while
governing together and defending the same privileges. Today, Fox returns to
the PRI. Sheinbaum summed it up as follows: "Fox is a traitor to democracy."
On one side, a vision for the nation; on the other, a return to corruption and
the past.

**Governance from the Grassroots: Listening to and Serving the People  
** More than 150,000 people attended Sheinbaum's public activities across 10
states. On each tour, requests concerning justice and public services are
received and addressed; urgent cases are given priority. Governing from the
grassroots means listening to and responding to the people.
